title: FRM® Part I Complete Course
shortDescription: The quantitative and market foundations of financial risk management, taught with intuition and heavy practice.
description: A full preparation course for FRM® Part I covering the foundations of risk management, quantitative analysis, financial markets and products, and valuation and risk models. Every lesson includes notes with formulas, a worked example and a quiz, supported by a 4-option question bank, flashcards, calculators and timed mock exams.
whoFor: Candidates registered for the FRM® Part I exam
Analysts in banks, asset managers, insurers or consultancies moving into risk roles
Engineering and science graduates who want to apply quantitative skills in finance
CFA® candidates who want deeper risk-management knowledge
outcomes: Compute and interpret VaR, expected shortfall and other risk measures
Price forwards, futures, swaps, bonds and options under no-arbitrage
Apply probability, statistics, regression and time-series tools to financial data
Understand how banks, insurers and funds measure and manage risk
Analyse famous risk-management failures and the lessons they teach

faq.q: How much maths do I need?
faq.a: Comfort with algebra and basic statistics helps. The Quantitative Analysis module builds the required probability, statistics and regression skills from the ground up.
Yes. Lessons show the steps you would perform on an exam-approved financial calculator, and the platform includes 30 interactive calculators to check your work.

faq.q: Are the questions official GARP questions?
faq.a: No. All questions are originally written for this course in an exam-like 4-option format.
Many candidates plan 200-300 hours for Part I. Use the study planner to generate a week-by-week schedule.

modules.title: Foundations of Risk Management
modules.description: What risk is, how firms govern and manage it, core portfolio theory, and the lessons of past failures.

lessons.title: The Building Blocks of Risk Management
lessons.summary: Risk versus uncertainty, expected and unexpected loss, risk types and the risk management process.

lessons.title: How Do Firms Manage Financial Risk?
lessons.summary: Retain, avoid, mitigate or transfer: hedging rationale and the risk appetite statement.

lessons.title: The Governance of Risk Management
lessons.summary: Board responsibilities, risk committees, the three lines of defence and risk culture.

lessons.title: Credit Risk Transfer Mechanisms
lessons.summary: Credit derivatives, CDOs, securitisation and their role in the 2007-2009 crisis.

lessons.title: Modern Portfolio Theory and the CAPM
lessons.summary: Efficient frontier, capital market line, beta and the CAPM.

lessons.title: Risk-Adjusted Performance Measures
lessons.summary: Sharpe, Treynor, Jensen's alpha, information ratio and Sortino ratio.

lessons.title: The Arbitrage Pricing Theory and Multifactor Models
lessons.summary: Factor models, factor sensitivities and hedging factor exposures.

lessons.title: Principles for Effective Data Aggregation and Risk Reporting
lessons.summary: Why risk data aggregation matters and the principles for reliable risk reporting.

lessons.title: Enterprise Risk Management and Future Trends
lessons.summary: Integrated ERM, risk culture, scenario analysis and emerging risks.

lessons.title: Learning From Financial Disasters
lessons.summary: Classic failures in liquidity, model, rogue-trading and operational risk and their lessons.

lessons.title: Anatomy of the Great Financial Crisis
lessons.summary: Causes of the 2007-2009 crisis: housing, leverage, funding runs and contagion.

lessons.title: The GARP Code of Conduct
lessons.summary: Principles of professional integrity, conflicts of interest and confidentiality.

modules.title: Quantitative Analysis
modules.description: Probability, statistics, regression, time series, simulation and machine learning for risk managers.

lessons.title: Fundamentals of Probability
lessons.summary: Events, independence, conditional probability and Bayes' rule.

lessons.title: Random Variables
lessons.summary: Discrete and continuous random variables, moments and quantiles.

lessons.title: Common Univariate Random Variables
lessons.summary: Bernoulli, binomial, Poisson, normal, lognormal, Student's t, chi-square and F distributions.

lessons.title: Multivariate Random Variables
lessons.summary: Joint, marginal and conditional distributions; covariance, correlation and portfolios.

lessons.title: Sample Moments
lessons.summary: Estimating mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis; bias, consistency and the CLT.

lessons.title: Hypothesis Testing
lessons.summary: Null and alternative hypotheses, test statistics, p-values, confidence intervals and power.

lessons.title: Linear Regression
lessons.summary: OLS estimation, interpretation, inference and goodness of fit.

lessons.title: Regression With Multiple Explanatory Variables
lessons.summary: Multiple regression, adjusted R-squared, F-tests and multicollinearity.

lessons.title: Regression Diagnostics
lessons.summary: Heteroskedasticity, omitted variables, outliers and model specification.

lessons.title: Stationary Time Series
lessons.summary: Autocorrelation, white noise, AR, MA and ARMA models and forecasting.

lessons.title: Non-Stationary Time Series
lessons.summary: Trends, seasonality, unit roots and spurious regression.

lessons.title: Measuring Returns, Volatility and Correlation
lessons.summary: Simple versus log returns, volatility estimation, non-normality and rank correlation.

lessons.title: Simulation and Bootstrapping
lessons.summary: Monte Carlo simulation, variance reduction and the bootstrap.

lessons.title: Machine Learning Methods
lessons.summary: Supervised and unsupervised learning, overfitting, regularisation and model evaluation.

modules.title: Financial Markets and Products
modules.description: Banks, insurers, funds, derivatives markets, clearing, futures, options, swaps and fixed income products.

lessons.title: Banks
lessons.summary: Bank business models, risks, capital and the originate-to-distribute model.

lessons.title: Insurance Companies and Pension Plans
lessons.summary: Life and property-casualty insurance, mortality tables, combined ratio and pension plans.

lessons.title: Fund Management
lessons.summary: Mutual funds, ETFs, hedge funds, fees and NAV.

lessons.title: Introduction to Derivatives
lessons.summary: Forwards, futures and options payoffs; hedgers, speculators and arbitrageurs.

lessons.title: Exchanges and OTC Markets
lessons.summary: Market structure, counterparty risk, margin and collateral.

lessons.title: Central Clearing
lessons.summary: How CCPs work, default waterfalls and the risks CCPs create.

lessons.title: Futures Markets
lessons.summary: Contract specifications, daily settlement, margin calls and delivery.

lessons.title: Using Futures for Hedging
lessons.summary: Basis risk, minimum-variance hedge ratio and hedging with stock index futures.

lessons.title: Interest Rates
lessons.summary: Compounding frequencies, zero rates, bond pricing, forward rates and FRAs.

lessons.title: Determination of Forward and Futures Prices
lessons.summary: Cost of carry for assets with income, yields, storage costs and currencies.

lessons.title: Commodity Forwards and Futures
lessons.summary: Storage, convenience yield, contango and backwardation.

lessons.title: Options Markets
lessons.summary: Option types, exchange-traded options, warrants and employee stock options.

lessons.title: Properties of Options
lessons.summary: Bounds on option prices, put-call parity and early exercise.

lessons.title: Trading Strategies
lessons.summary: Covered calls, protective puts, spreads, straddles and strangles.

lessons.title: Exotic Options
lessons.summary: Barrier, Asian, lookback, binary and compound options.

lessons.title: Properties of Interest Rate Swaps and Currency Swaps
lessons.summary: Swap mechanics, comparative advantage, valuation and the role of OIS discounting.

lessons.title: Foreign Exchange Risk and Corporate Bonds
lessons.summary: Managing FX exposure; bond indentures, ratings, recovery and yield spreads.

lessons.title: Mortgages and Mortgage-Backed Securities
lessons.summary: Mortgage cash flows, prepayment, pass-throughs, CMOs and the dollar roll.

modules.title: Valuation and Risk Models
modules.description: VaR and expected shortfall, credit ratings, operational risk, stress testing, bond and option valuation.

lessons.title: Measures of Financial Risk
lessons.summary: Mean-variance limits, VaR, expected shortfall and coherent risk measures.

lessons.title: Calculating and Applying VaR
lessons.summary: Historical simulation, delta-normal and Monte Carlo VaR for linear and non-linear positions.

lessons.title: Measuring and Monitoring Volatility
lessons.summary: EWMA, GARCH(1,1), volatility term structure and correlation estimation.

lessons.title: External and Internal Credit Ratings
lessons.summary: Rating scales, transition matrices, through-the-cycle versus point-in-time ratings.

lessons.title: Country Risk: Determinants, Measures and Implications
lessons.summary: Sources of country risk, sovereign default and sovereign ratings.

lessons.title: Measuring Credit Risk
lessons.summary: Expected loss, unexpected loss, Vasicek model and the Basel capital formula intuition.

lessons.title: Operational Risk
lessons.summary: Loss categories, measurement approaches and the standardised approach.

lessons.title: Stress Testing
lessons.summary: Scenario design, reverse stress tests and governance of stress testing.

lessons.title: Pricing Conventions, Discounting and Arbitrage
lessons.summary: Discount factors, the law of one price and replicating bond cash flows.

lessons.title: Interest Rates: Spot, Forward and Par
lessons.summary: Bootstrapping, deriving forward rates and par rates.

lessons.title: Returns, Spreads and Yields
lessons.summary: Realized return, spreads, yield to maturity and carry roll-down.

lessons.title: One-Factor Risk Metrics and Hedges

lessons.title: Multi-Factor Risk Metrics and Hedges
lessons.summary: Key rate durations, partial 01s and bucket hedging.

lessons.title: Binomial Trees
lessons.summary: Pricing European and American options in one- and multi-step trees.

lessons.title: The Black-Scholes-Merton Model
lessons.summary: Assumptions, pricing formula, dividends and implied volatility.

lessons.title: Option Sensitivity Measures: The Greeks
